name: portainer-console
description: Portainer as an optional container console: a browser surface an operator runs beside the stack and reaches from the portal. cockpit and portainer allows shipping it as a module and documents it; nothing in this repository starts it, and no Cockpit entry exists here because Cockpit is a host package and not a container. It is a declaration of an integration, not an action: no entry grants a write path.
if_disabled: The portal shows no console link and container management stays with whatever tool the operator already uses; collection, detection and incident state are untouched.
